title: THE 242 SUBDIVISIONS OF IDEONOMY REDUCED BY SUBSUMPTION TO 50? (Or To A Four-Level Hierarchy of 7 Phyla, 30 Classes, 12 Orders, and 1 Family - of Divisions)

lists.name: Subdivisions of Ideonomy
items: DESCRIPTIONS, MEASURES AND MEASUREMENTS (Or Mathematical Things?), ANADESCRIPTIONS (or Recursions?), MATHEMATICAL THINGS, QUANTITIES, ANALYSES, EVALUATIONS, INTERPRETATIONS, CRITICISMS (Or Defects):
VALUES, INTERESTS, BEAUTIES, OUGHTS, BADS, ERRORS (or Illusions, Disproofs), DEFECTS, PATHOSES.
DIFFERENCES, NEGATIVE ANALOGIES, EQUIVALENCES, VIRTUALS, IDENTITIES, COMMONALITIES, METAPHORS:
NETWORKS OF CONSEQUENCES (or Networks?), REACTIONS, COROLLARIES, IMPLICATIONS;
'GROUPS' (or Sets?), EMERGENTS (or Surprises?), MOTIONS, FLOWS (or Courses?), BEHAVIORS, ACTS, PROCESSES, OPERATIONS:
DISJUNCTIONS, ALTERNATIVES, DECISIONS; BRANCHES, TREES, RADIATIONS, AND VECTORS.
COEVOLUTIONS, COURSES (or Paths?), HISTORIES, FUTURES AND FUTURIBLES, GENESES (development), ORIGINS, ULTIMATES AND ENDS.
WISDOMS, INTERKNOWLEDGES, IGNORANCES, UNCERTAINTIES AND DOUBTS, LAWS (or Generalizations?), RULES:
SPECULATIONS, BELIEFS, ASSUMPTIONS, DOCTRINES, ORTHODOXIES, HETERODOXIES, WORLD VIEWS, PARADIGMS:
COORDINATE SYSTEMS, INTERREPRESENTATIONS, MODELS, SIMULATIONS, LANGUAGES:
FICTIONS, EXPECTATIONS (or Beliefs?), CHANCES, SURPRISES (or Discoveries?), ANOMALIES.
